convert_ints_to_bytes: convert a list of integers in the range 0-255 to a bytes object using ints2bytes
convert_bytes_to_ints: convert a bytes object to a list of integers using bytes2ints
check_interval_intersection: check if two numeric intervals intersect using intervals_intersect
print_colored_token_ids: print token ids with special tokens highlighted in red using pprint_token_ids
get_tokenizer_model_type: get the tokenizer model type like BPE or ByteLevelBPE for a given HuggingFace model
